title: resourceContext
responsibility: Builds a lease environment with bounded CPU, RAM and native threads, and records child process identity.

inputs.name: resourceContext.id
inputs.description: Lease id that ResourceQueueService.enqueue creates with randomUUID() and also uses as the queue job id. It is written to HARNESS_RESOURCE_LEASE and is the key that track() patches; this function does not check its format, but ResourceQueueRepository.all() fails on any stored job whose id is not a UUID.

inputs.name: resourceContext.request
inputs.description: Requested priority, cpus and memoryMiB, which become the HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY, HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS and HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB env values; label is not read here. No capacity check happens in this function, and ResourceQueueService.run parses the request with resourceRequestSchema (a known priority, positive finite cpus and memoryMiB) before calling it.

inputs.name: resourceContext.env
inputs.description: Caller environment: every key is copied into the returned env without filtering, so secrets in it are returned too. HARNESS_RESOURCE_LEASE, HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS, HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB and HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY overwrite same-named keys, and when the lease CPU count is positive, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS, RAYON_NUM_THREADS, GOMAXPROCS and OMP_NUM_THREADS are set to that count rounded down to at least 1, or to a lower caller value of at least 1 rounded down.

inputs.name: resourceContext.queue
inputs.description: Shared ResourceQueueRepository whose patch() sets workerPid and workerStarted on the job with this lease id. Only track() uses it, and track() skips it when the PID is reported absent; patch() does nothing when no job has this lease id.

outputs.name: resourceContext
outputs.description: Lease context with the id, the child env (caller env plus HARNESS_RESOURCE_* values and thread caps) and track(pid). track(pid) writes nothing when the system reports the PID absent; otherwise, including when the system could not be asked, it sets workerPid and sets workerStarted to the process start time, or clears it when that time is unavailable.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by resourceContext when request is null or undefined, because request.cpus is read while building the env; track(pid) throws it for a null or undefined queue when the PID is not reported absent.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by track(pid) when any stored job fails resourceJobSchema validation, because patch() parses every job through ResourceQueueRepository.all() before it updates the matching one.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by track(pid) when any stored job record is not valid JSON, because ResourceQueueRepository.all() parses every record before patch() updates the matching one.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by track(pid) when the SQLite driver (bun:sqlite under Bun, node:sqlite under Node) fails on BEGIN IMMEDIATE, a read, a write or COMMIT; errors after BEGIN are rolled back and rethrown unchanged.
